mapper.sql: s.id, s.question_type, s.question_id, s.author_id, s.title, s.content_md, s.status, s.version, s.client_request_id, s.request_hash, s.last_management_reason, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted_at
LEFT JOIN `question` q ON s.question_type = 'ALGO' AND q.id = s.question_id LEFT JOIN `db_question` d ON s.question_type = 'DB' AND d.id = s.question_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `solution` (question_type, question_id, author_id, title, content_md, status, version, client_request_id, request_hash, last_management_reason) VALUES (#{questionType}, #{questionId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{contentMd}, #{status}, #{version}, #{clientRequestId}, #{requestHash}, #{lastManagementReason})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `solution` s WHERE s.author_id = #{authorId} AND s.client_request_id = #{clientRequestId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `solution` s
WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND AND s.question_type = #{questionType} AND s.question_id = #{questionId}
SELECT FROM `solution` s WHERE s.author_id = #{authorId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `solution` s WHERE s.author_id = #{authorId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM `solution` s INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = s.author_id
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `solution` s INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = s.author_id
mapper.update: UPDATE `solution` SET title = #{title}, content_md = #{contentMd}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE `solution` SET status = #{status}, last_management_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE `solution` SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
